name: Volunteer at the YMCA of Greater San Francisco (ages 15 and up)
city: San Francisco, CA (and other YMCA of Greater San Francisco branches)
what_you_do: You help at a YMCA branch with youth programs, events, older adults or special drives. You can count the time toward school service hours.
who_can_apply: Anyone at least 15 years old. No experience is needed. Some roles need a background check, and new volunteers go through a reference check.
duration: No daily minimum. The schedule is set with you.
deadline_text: Apply any time. No deadline is posted.
how_to_apply: Download the Volunteer Application form from the page and email the completed PDF to volunteer@ymcasf.org. Staff follow up within 2 business days. You can name a preferred branch and program area.
notes: The FAQ says students can earn school service hours here. Your references are checked online, so it depends on how fast they reply. The Y has branches in San Francisco, on the Peninsula and in Marin. The page also offers group volunteering for 3 or more people.
